## What this region is

The margin file and its lifecycle: the.gloss/ mirror layout and markdown format, the harvester that writes it from source comments, and the bidirectional dagger↔section check and its repair.

## What it exists for

- Find where a sidecar is, or which source a sidecar belongs to
- Read or change a sidecar's markdown as data
- Move source comments into sidecars and plant daggers
- Make harvesting and checking happen on every commit and push
- Keep some files out of harvest, lint and check
- Find and repair daggers and sections that no longer pair

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- is this comment allowed to stay in the source file → comment-rule-and-source-scanning
- add our own annotation comments to the protected directive list → comment-rule-and-source-scanning
- show me the note with how many times the symbol changed since → read-and-staleness
- show the margin note automatically when the agent reads a file → agent-integration-setup-and-cli
- install the Read and Grep hooks into the Claude settings file → agent-integration-setup-and-cli
